confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live menus, booking pages or listings were checked. Restaurant anchors are the firmest; hostel and hotel rates vary widely in July peak season. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 1.8x beer, wine glass about 1.1x beer) because direct knowledge is only moderate. GBP was converted at an assumed general-knowledge rate of roughly 1.33 USD per GBP, not a fetched rate, so a 5% GBP/USD move shifts all anchors by about 5%. The RBA rate came from search summaries attributing it to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page; that page was not read directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized English regional cities with similar tourism and student demand, such as Manchester, Birmingham and Leeds, with accommodation set below London levels. Based on general model knowledge, not live listings.
